column1: # The D7 bindings of the target P/01/production (task P01.136; README «D7 test-side evidence bindings», forms/d7-payload.schema.json). Stand data: judge only.
# One row per activation of a binding of an entry of Platform/01-store/forms/production.tsv; the scope of the descriptor of the entry is P/01/production#<id>.
# id: an entry executed by itself (executed_by -). An entry executed by a probe has no row of its own: its activations are the rows of the probe with step = its id.
# step: the group that the activation serves inside a probe, - otherwise. capability: clock, storage, progress or fault; - when the entry needs no D7 binding.
# binding: the payload of activate without targets and without the offset_seconds of a controlled domain, which the judge sets at each activation; - with capability -.
# basis: the row of the norm that names the need. The rows add no outcome, number or provider; the descriptor with identity, invoke, refs and source_pin is the stand's.
